name: YM Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: YM Tech Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the development and manufacturing of high-voltage switching components. Their product line features a variety of relays, including EV Relays in multiple current ratings for electric vehicles, and DC Contactor Relays utilized in applications such as electric golf carts, forklifts, and lifts. The company's offerings further extend to Power Relays, Latch Relays, and specialized Military Relays. Established in 2004, YM Tech Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Cheongju-si, South Korea.
